about: The source model of a NumPy .npy file or .npz archive (spec/zarrify/npy.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/npy.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, the tables of data types, and the roles the file, an NPY preamble, header and data, and a .npz archive's ZIP structures and members play, each with the constraints the input must meet (spec/zarrify/npy.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/npy.md#8-numpy-profile>). The parser checks them in this order. A .npz member's NPY roles (and inflated_size, a deflated member's) do not reject the input: a member that fails one is not presented, with the role's reason. Projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

types.about: a type string's kind and size: its Zarr data type and element size (spec/zarrify/npy.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/npy.md#3-data-types>); U<n>, S<n>, V<n>, M8[...] and m8[...] are read by their own rules

unsupported.about: type strings the profile names and does not present
unsupported.O: an object array holds a pickle
unsupported.f12: a long double has no Zarr data type
unsupported.f16: a long double has no Zarr data type
unsupported.c24: a long double has no Zarr data type
unsupported.c32: a long double has no Zarr data type

units.about: the units of a datetime64 or timedelta64

elements.about: The IR of a NumPy file. In a .npy file the NPY elements are the root's; in a .npz archive, a stored member's, below entries/<i>/data. p is the preamble's length (10 or 12), n the header's, B the data's.

data.extent: (o + p + n, B), when presented and B > 0

end, end_comment, zip64_locator, zip64_e.about: a .npz archive's end records and central directory (spec/zarrify/safe.md §6.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/safe.md#63-the-source-metadata-node>)

entries/<i>.extent: [lho, ds + cs): member i's local header (local_header, name, extra) and data

entries/<i>/data.about: a stored member whose NPY preamble and header were read (struct); a deflated member (derived, form {transform: deflate}), whose preamble and header, when read, are in the source metadata; any other member's bytes (value bytes[cs])

gaps/<offset>.about: bytes no other element claims: a stored member's bytes after its header when it is not presented, and after its data; data descriptors; bytes after a .npy file's data

given.size: the bytes of the file (or member) the preamble starts

constraints.message: a deflated member's NPY header ends past byte {end} of its stream
